incident.title: payment-service requests timing out, 5xx rising
incident.description: Since 2026-09-24 22:20 UTC many payment-service requests hang for seconds and then fail. The errors mention timeouts while talking to orders-db. CPU on the service and on the database looks normal.

incident.title: checkout-api error rate up after today's release
incident.description: Shortly after checkout-api v4.1.2 was rolled out with ArgoCD, users started getting server errors and some of the new pods keep restarting.

incident.title: inventory-service pods restarting every few hours
incident.description: inventory-service pods are killed and restarted regularly. Before each restart the service gets slower and its memory usage climbs steadily.

incident.title: auth-service cannot reach its dependencies
incident.description: Since 2026-09-20 03:06 UTC outbound calls from auth-service fail with host lookup errors, although the dependencies themselves report healthy.
